metadata.notes: Every row is USDA FoodData Central (public domain) with per-row provenance and no nutrient rows merged across sources under one id. The catalog spans three FDC datasets: Foundation Foods, and two FNDDS survey releases. EU-origin national food-composition databases (CIQUAL, CoFID, Fineli, EuroFIR) were evaluated and are not bundled: each would need its own redistribution review, and none covers Hungarian/Turkish dishes, which remain the main uncovered cuisine. Composite dishes (soups, mixed dishes, sandwiches, pizza, breakfast) come from FNDDS 2021-2023 and are regenerable from the pinned release via scripts/capture-food-extracts.ts; the older Foundation/FNDDS rows are a frozen extract that upstream no longer reproduces.
